title: epipactis atropurpurea subvar. lutescens
intro: Epipactis atropurpurea subvar. lutescens, commonly known as Yellow Helleborine, is a subvarietal form of the Epipactis atropurpurea orchid species. It is a type of flowering plant native to Europe, with potential health benefits attributed to its unique properties. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Helleborine are believed to be attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system support. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and potential uses.
